title: Add  Search Engine
body:
### What is the user problem or growth opportunity you want to see solved?
users need som others search engine like duckduckgo, by default 

### How do you know that this problem exists today? Why is this important?
users need privacy so better add duckduck go in search engines in firefox by default.

### Who will benefit from it?

┆Issue is synchronized with this [Jira Task](https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FNXV2-4005)

comments.body: You already can add other search engines.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
> You already can add other search engines.

This behaviour currently blocked by https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/12954

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body:
* Open Firefox
* Tap 3 dot menu
* Tap `Settings`
* Tap `Search`
* Tap `Add search engine`
* Fill out the correct information
